description: Read one public post in full, FRESH at request time: author, text, created_at, a media summary and counts (reactions in total and by type, comments, reshares). Costs $0.0012 per live read; a post that cannot be found is free. Give one of post_id, share_id or post_url. While GET /pricing does not list this route in its family's available_routes it answers 503 temporarily_unavailable and nothing is charged.

post_id.description: The post: the post reference the posts read returns (id), its numeric activity id, or its activity, share or ugcPost URN as the post's address shows it.

share_id.description: The post's content id: the share_id the posts read returns, a numeric id, or its share or ugcPost URN as the post's address shows it.

name: post_get
title: Read Post
